'''Business and economy'''
*The [[Bangladesh]]i [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment industry]] [[Worker standards board|wage board]] agrees to increase [[minimum wage]]s following five days of [[Strike action|worker protests]] and clashes with [[Bangladesh Police|police]]. Workers demand [[Bangladeshi taka|৳]]30,000 ([[US$]]240) monthly, up from ৳12,500 (US$100), while the board has not specified the increase. '''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 Southeast Asian haze]]
**The [[Singapore]]an [[Parliament of Singapore|parliament]] amends the [[Transboundary Haze Pollution Act of 2014]], introducing [[Law enforcement in Singapore|arrest powers]], permitting [[Judicial system of Singapore|trials]] without [[defendant]]s present, and increasing maximum fines tenfold to [[S$]]20 million (US$15 million) following widespread [[Environmental issues in Singapore|air pollution]] from [[Indonesia]]n [[2026 Indonesia wildfires|wildfires]]. [https://www.afp.com/en/singapore-toughens-haze-law-arrest-powers-bigger-fines (AFP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Philippines|Philippine]] authorities seize a {{convert|200|kg|lb|adj=on}} shipment of [[methamphetamine]], whose origin is traced to [[Laos]], at the [[Port of Manila|Manila International Container Port]]. The shipment had arrived six days after local police in Laos [[2026 Laos private jet drug smuggling case|found the similar contraband, supposed to be brought to the Philippines,]] on October 1. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Hungary]] makes [[Hungarian People's Republic|Communist-era]] [[secret police]] records publicly accessible through a [[database]] containing approximately 60,000 names linked to former [[Ministry of Internal Affairs III|state security services]]. [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Péter Magyar]] announces that additional documents will become available in February 2027. [https://www.reuters.com/world/hungary-opens-communist-era-informer-files-belated-reckoning-with-cold-war-past-2026-11-04/ (Reuters)]
